sloka: ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते प्रविवेश महारथः ।अयोध्यां रत्नसम्पूर्णां हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताम् ।। ७.५२.२ ॥
transliteration: tato 'rdhadivase prāpte praviveśa mahārathaḥ ।ayodhyāṁ ratnasampūrṇāṁ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtām ।। 7.52.2 ॥

translations.english: Then, at midday, the great warrior Lakshmana entered Ayodhya, which was full of jewels and teeming with happy and well-nourished people.
